categories.name: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives

skills.name: Saboteur
skills.category: Category 1: Classes & Specializations
skills.description: Grants +1 Sabotage per level above 5 (e.g., Level 6 = +1, Level 10 = +5). At the start of each battle or Raid wave, each point of Sabotage disables one random weapon carried by an enemy trooper.

skills.name: Doctor
skills.category: Category 1: Classes & Specializations
skills.description: Heals an injured teammate for 5 HP at Level 6 (+1 HP per additional level), cures poison and paralysis, repairs crippled limbs, and makes the Doctor personally immune to poison and paralysis.

skills.name: Soldier
skills.category: Category 1: Classes & Specializations
skills.description: Grants +1 max HP for every level the trooper has (retroactive and future levels) and provides a combat helmet that caps incoming headshot damage at a maximum of 2 damage.

skills.name: Munitions
skills.category: Category 1: Classes & Specializations
skills.description: Doubles the frequency of grenade throws across the squad (2x grenade rate) and automatically reloads all weapons for 1 teammate per level above 5 when reinforcements arrive.

skills.name: Scout
skills.category: Category 1: Classes & Specializations
skills.description: Grants +1 squad deployment slot per Scout (raising base deployment from 4 up to a hard cap of 20). Does not scale with additional levels.

skills.name: Comms. Officer
skills.category: Category 1: Classes & Specializations
skills.description: Starts with +5 Communication points at Level 6 and gains +1 Communication per level-up thereafter, unlocking global battle orders (Solo Mission, Locked, Support, Retreat at 10+, and Propaganda at 20+).

skills.name: Pilot
skills.category: Category 1: Classes & Specializations
skills.description: Increases the probability of deploying any owned vehicle (Light Tank, Heavy Tank, Helicopter, Fighter Jet) into combat by +25% per level-up.

skills.name: Spy
skills.category: Category 1: Classes & Specializations
skills.description: Allows the trooper to infiltrate and spawn directly inside the enemy camp at the start of combat with +50 Initiative (+10 Initiative per additional level) while reducing enemy deployment capacity by -1.

skills.name: Pistol
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Basic starting sidearm with no special modifiers.

skills.name: Revolver
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Always loaded at the start of a fight and knocks the enemy down on hit.

skills.name: Desert Eagle
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Ignores enemy armor completely and has long handgun range.

skills.name: Beretta
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Ultra-low recovery time (50), allowing rapid follow-up shots.

skills.name: Dual Pistols
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Fires twice per burst for high close-to-mid-range handgun output.

skills.name: Shotgun
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Deals zone damage and knocks the enemy down on hit.

skills.name: Pump Action Shotgun
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Reloads automatically after firing, deals zone damage, and knocks the enemy down.

skills.name: Double-Barrelled Shotgun
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Fires twice per burst, deals zone damage, and knocks the enemy down.

skills.name: Scattergun
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Features an extended damage zone (wider AoE cone) and knocks enemies down.

skills.name: Semi-Auto Shotgun
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: High magazine capacity (4 shells) with very fast 70 recovery, zone damage, and knockdown.

skills.name: Assault Rifle
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Standard balanced starting rifle.

skills.name: M16
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Upgraded Assault Rifle with double crit rate (x10), faster recovery (80), and a 4-burst magazine (12).

skills.name: Thompson
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Ignores enemy armor completely and rolls high burst damage (9-21).

skills.name: AK47
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Fires 4 bullets per burst with 100% base accuracy and slightly longer range (2-7).

skills.name: FAMAS
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Ultra-low recovery (50) and can fire at point-blank range (1-5).

skills.name: UMP
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Features a massive x20 Critical Multiplier and 100% base accuracy.

skills.name: Sniper
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Hits favourite target body part more often; requires a secure zone (no adjacent enemies) to fire.

skills.name: SparrowHawk
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Heavy weapon with the highest accuracy (300%) and fatal killshot multiplier (x50) in the game.

skills.name: MOS-TECK
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Heavy weapon with massive raw per-shot damage (6-7) and a 3-round magazine.

skills.name: CK-Magellan
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Semi-auto heavy sniper with a large 6-shot clip, shorter minimum range (2), and fast 65 recovery.

skills.name: Lizaro Jungle
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Mid-tier heavy sniper rifle holding 2 rounds per magazine with solid base damage (5).

skills.name: Comanche Auto
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Heavy weapon combining high accuracy (90%), fast recovery (60), and 6-round bursts.

skills.name: Gatling Gun
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Long-range (7) heavy weapon capable of up to 30 damage per burst.

skills.name: Heavy Machine Gun
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Heavy weapon that always starts loaded at the beginning of a fight and fires 8 bullets per burst.

skills.name: Minigun
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Heavy weapon with 100% base accuracy and fast 80 recovery.

skills.name: Rocket Launcher
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Explosive AoE launcher that tosses enemies into the air (inflicting 1-5 fall damage) and is NOT classified as a Heavy weapon (no movement speed penalty).

skills.name: Bazooka M1
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Heavy explosive weapon with improved accuracy (75%) and blast radius; deals double damage to vehicles.

skills.name: Bazooka M25
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Multi-shot heavy launcher holding 3 rockets per clip with faster 80 recovery for sustained AoE bombardment.

skills.name: Infernal Tube
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Single-shot heavy launcher with devastating 14-28 AoE blast damage and 95% base accuracy.

skills.name: Knife
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Ultra-fast melee weapon (40 recovery) that never runs out of ammo and can score x10 critical killshots.

skills.name: Hydroshock Shells
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: All bullets fired are 4 times as likely (4x) to knock the enemy down, cancelling their current action. Consumes 1 Equipment slot; does not apply to Launchers.

skills.name: Paralysing Shells
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Bullets have a chance on hit to paralyse the target, freezing their turn gauge. Consumes 1 Equipment slot; does not apply to Launchers.

skills.name: Toxic Shells
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Bullets poison the enemy on hit, dealing damage over time each turn unless cured by a Doctor. Consumes 1 Equipment slot; does not apply to Launchers.

skills.name: Explosive Shells
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Doubles bullet damage (2x damage) for up to 6 shots/bursts. Consumes 1 Equipment slot; does not apply to Launchers.

skills.name: Armor-Piercing Shells
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Ignores all target armor (Bulletproof Vest, Heavy Armor) and deals bonus damage to armored vehicles. Consumes 1 Equipment slot; does not apply to Launchers.

skills.name: Grenade
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Standard explosive grenade dealing AoE blast damage (4-8) and tossing hit enemies into the air. Consumes 1 Equipment slot.

skills.name: Fragmentation Grenade
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Upgraded high-shrapnel grenade with a larger blast zone and higher base damage (6-12) that damages multiple body parts. Consumes 1 Equipment slot.

skills.name: Flashbang
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Non-lethal tactical grenade that blinds and stuns all enemies caught in the blast zone, drastically reducing their Aim and Initiative. Consumes 1 Equipment slot.

skills.name: Gas Grenade
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Releases a toxic cloud that poisons all troopers in the target area, dealing recurring HP damage each turn. Consumes 1 Equipment slot.

skills.name: Glue Grenade
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Coats the target zone in adhesive, immobilizing hit enemies so they cannot move or dodge. Consumes 1 Equipment slot.

skills.name: Shock Grenade
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Releases an electrical blast that disarms hit enemies (forcing them to drop their active weapon) and briefly stuns them. Consumes 1 Equipment slot.

skills.name: Clown Grenade
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Psychological/Trick grenade (Pink/Clown grenade) that confuses and distracts enemies in the blast radius (countered by Smart). Consumes 1 Equipment slot.

skills.name: Grenade Benny
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Allows the trooper to hurl a massive bundle of grenades dealing 12-24 AoE damage across a huge radius.

skills.name: Healing Grenade
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: Doctor-exclusive support grenade that heals allies and cures status effects in the target splash zone. Consumes 1 Equipment slot.

skills.name: Black Hole Grenade
skills.category: Category 2: Weapons, Ammunition & Grenades
skills.description: High-tier gravity grenade that pulls nearby troopers into the center of the blast and inflicts heavy crushing damage. Consumes 1 Equipment slot.

skills.name: Loader
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: The trooper's primary/selected weapon starts the battle already loaded, skipping the turn-1 reload animation.

skills.name: Nimble Fingers
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Operates weapons twice as quickly and loads 2 shells at a time into single-shell weapons (like Shotguns and Snipers).

skills.name: Twinoid
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Consumes a Twinoid pill to gain +500 Initiative and fire/act twice per cycle.

skills.name: Trigger Happy
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Fires an extra burst/shot whenever attacking with a firearm.

skills.name: Tail Gunner
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Fires 2 additional bursts when using an automatic / machine gun weapon.

skills.name: Nervous
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: The trooper occasionally panics and empties their entire magazine clip into the target in a single turn.

skills.name: Juggler
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Allows the trooper to switch between carried weapons instantly (0 recovery cost).

skills.name: Battle-Ready
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Automatically reloads the equipped weapon while moving across the battlefield.

skills.name: Rucksack
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: After moving once, the trooper's weapons and ammunition reserves are fully replenished.

skills.name: Covering Fire
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Shots fired by this trooper suppress the target, reducing the enemy's Initiative and delaying their next turn.

skills.name: Last Mohican
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: If the trooper is the last surviving member of your squad on the field, they empty their entire clip and deal double (2x) damage.

skills.name: Unshakable
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Being shot in the arm or hit by enemies does not cause the trooper to drop their weapon or suffer performance penalties.

skills.name: Laser Sights
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants +80% Aim bonus to equipped firearms.

skills.name: Eye of the Tiger
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants +50% Aim with all firearms.

skills.name: Heat Sensor
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants +20% Aim and prevents the targeted enemy from dodging the shot.

skills.name: Barrel Extension
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants +1 Range and +10% Aim for all firearms.

skills.name: Compensator
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Reduces aiming wait/recovery time between bursts and stabilizes recoil.

skills.name: Biped
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Eliminates the accuracy penalty when firing at moving targets.

skills.name: Cold Blooded
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: The trooper takes aim twice as quickly (halves aiming time, huge for Snipers and Launchers).

skills.name: Anatomy
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Dramatically increases the chance of scoring an instant Fatal Killshot and hitting the trooper's Favourite Target body part.

skills.name: Heartbreaker
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Greatly increases the chance of scoring an instant Killshot when hitting the enemy in the heart.

skills.name: Vicious
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Increases the probability of hitting already-wounded body parts to cripple limbs faster.

skills.name: Unforgiving
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Always inflicts maximum weapon damage against an opponent this trooper has already hit once.

skills.name: Blind Fury
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Negates sight/accuracy penalties from Flashbangs or eye injuries, allowing the trooper to keep firing accurately even when blinded.

skills.name: On Point
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants +200 Initiative at the start of combat so the trooper acts before everyone else.

skills.name: Sprinter
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Increases the trooper's movement speed by +100% (2x Speed).

skills.name: Thermos of Coffee
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants a permanent +25% Speed boost.

skills.name: Adrenaline
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants an immediate burst of Initiative and Speed whenever the trooper takes damage or enters critical combat.

skills.name: Frenetic
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Whenever this trooper defeats/kills an enemy, they immediately gain +200 Initiative to chain another turn.

skills.name: Enthusiastic
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants +25% Speed while the trooper is at 100% full HP.

skills.name: Survival Instinct
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants +50% Speed whenever the trooper drops below 50% of their max HP.

skills.name: Hyperactive
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants +50% Speed and causes the trooper to run around erratically, interfering with enemy targeting.

skills.name: Amphetamine Shot
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Doctor-exclusive syringe that grants +100% Speed (2x Speed) for 500 turns.

skills.name: Hurry
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants +10% Speed and doubles (+100%) the frequency of using special class powers and equipment.

skills.name: Restless
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Whenever any trooper moves on the battlefield, this trooper gains +200 Initiative.

skills.name: Bounce Back
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: The trooper takes no fall damage when blasted into the air and immediately gains Initiative upon getting back up.

skills.name: Zigzag
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: The trooper runs in a zigzag pattern while advancing, making them significantly harder to hit while moving.

skills.name: Rush
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: The trooper immediately rushes forward toward the enemy line at the start of combat to get within weapon range.

skills.name: Charge
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Automatically charges into hand-to-hand range whenever an enemy is nearby.

skills.name: Wife Beater
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants +30% Speed and +30% Dodge chance.

skills.name: Smart
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Increases level-up skill choices from 2 to 3 options every level; also counters enemy Propaganda, Bait, Clown Grenades, and slightly reduces enemy Sabotage effectiveness.

skills.name: Suspicious
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants 100% immunity to allied Friendly Fire, 100% immunity to enemy Sabotage, and +200 Initiative for every enemy Spy on the field (unlocked at Level 7+).

skills.name: Vendetta
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants +50 Initiative and prioritizes attacking the specific enemy who last injured this trooper or killed an ally.

skills.name: Faceboot
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: When engaging an enemy in hand-to-hand combat, delivers a powerful kick to the opponent's face that knocks them back.

skills.name: Fists of Fury
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grants +1 damage to punches and a 50% chance to disarm the opponent (forcing them to drop their weapon).

skills.name: Wrestler
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: In hand-to-hand combat, throws the opponent into the air, inflicting fall damage (1-5) and knocking them down.

skills.name: Stamp
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Tramples knocked-down enemies on the ground for extra melee damage as the trooper runs past them.

skills.name: Death Grip
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Increases fist damage, never drops weapons, and never loses lock on the current target.

skills.name: King of Boules
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Grenades thrown by this trooper never miss their target.

skills.name: Interception
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Allows the trooper to catch or bat away incoming enemy grenades, throwing them back before they detonate.

skills.name: Reverse Attack
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Immediately executes a counter-attack whenever hit by an enemy at close/mid range.

skills.name: Out of Bounds
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: If knocked or pushed to the edge of the battlefield, the trooper re-positions behind the enemy or avoids out-of-bounds penalties.

skills.name: Talky-Walky
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Calls in reinforcement backup waves at the start of combat.

skills.name: Binoculars
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: Increases squad spotting range and removes long-range accuracy penalties for allied fire.

skills.name: Friendly Fire
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: The trooper fires into crowded melee scrums without hesitation—increases firing frequency when allies are in the line of fire (dangerous unless allies have Suspicious).

skills.name: Crybaby
skills.category: Category 3: Active Combat, Aim, Speed & Tactical Skills
skills.description: When injured, the trooper cries out so enemies stop targeting them or allies rush to their defense.

skills.name: Bulletproof Vest
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Grants +1 Armor (reduces incoming bullet damage by 1 per hit) and halves the chance of suffering critical/organ hits.

skills.name: Heavy Armor
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Grants heavy damage reduction (-1 to -2 damage per bullet), at the cost of -20% movement Speed.

skills.name: Full Metal Balaclava
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Protects the trooper's head, reducing incoming headshot damage and preventing facial/eye critical injuries.

skills.name: Hard Boiled
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: The trooper incurs zero speed or accuracy penalties when injured (crippled arms/legs still function at 100%).

skills.name: Invincible
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Renders the trooper completely immune to instant Fatal Killshots (enemies must deplete their full HP bar to kill them).

skills.name: Sturdy
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Grants +3 HP and completely negates the -50% movement speed penalty for carrying Heavy Weapons.

skills.name: Huge Calves
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Grants +3 HP and +25% movement Speed.

skills.name: Heavyweight
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Grants +10 HP, at the cost of -20% movement Speed.

skills.name: Brick Shouse
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Grants a massive HP boost and allows the trooper's bulky frame to act as physical cover for teammates behind them.

skills.name: Bait
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Grants bonus HP and makes the trooper much easier/more likely to be targeted by enemies, drawing fire away from fragile specialists.

skills.name: Dodger
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: The first shot fired at this trooper is automatically dodged, with an ongoing passive bonus to dodge subsequent attacks.

skills.name: Tuck 'n' Roll
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: The trooper rolls on the ground to evade incoming bursts and explosive blasts.

skills.name: Take Cover!
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Whenever the trooper is reloading, 50% of enemy shots fired at them automatically miss.

skills.name: Camouflage
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Significantly reduces the chance of being targeted by enemies and increases the chance that enemy shots miss at range.

skills.name: Commando
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Grants stealth evasion and bonus combat effectiveness when infiltrating or fighting from cover.

skills.name: Survivor
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Allows the trooper to survive a fatal blow with 1 HP (or crawl out alive after their vehicle is destroyed).

skills.name: First Aid
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Automatically replenishes HP once the trooper drops below 50% life points.

skills.name: Saviour
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Doctor-exclusive skill that allows the Doctor to revive/resuscitate a fallen teammate during combat.

skills.name: Lucky Charm
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Increases the trooper's luck, reducing enemy critical hit chances and improving survival rolls.

skills.name: Fall Guy
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: Absorbs or redirects incoming lethal shots aimed at nearby high-value allies.

skills.name: Martyr
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.description: When this trooper is killed in combat, they detonate an explosive / grant a massive buff to avenge their death.

skills.name: Radio
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.subCategory: 4E. Global Army, Economy & Special Utility Passives
skills.description: Grants +1 Communication bonus to the army (stacks with Comms. Officers).

skills.name: Commander
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.subCategory: 4E. Global Army, Economy & Special Utility Passives
skills.description: Grants the account +1 extra Battle per day (up to a maximum of +2 extra battles per day).

skills.name: Occupation
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.subCategory: 4E. Global Army, Economy & Special Utility Passives
skills.description: The trooper earns +1 Credit (T) every day passively for your account.

skills.name: Scavenger
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.subCategory: 4E. Global Army, Economy & Special Utility Passives
skills.description: Allows the trooper to loot weapons/equipment from fallen enemies or generate bonus post-battle rewards.

skills.name: Voodoo Doll
skills.category: Category 4: Armor, Survival, HP & Utility Passives
skills.subCategory: 4E. Global Army, Economy & Special Utility Passives
skills.description: Curses a random enemy trooper at the start of combat, inflicting damage or status penalties remotely.

skills.name: Motorcycle
skills.category: Category 5: Vehicles
skills.description: Consumes 1 Deployment Slot. Immediately drives the trooper into close range of the nearest enemy at the start of the fight.

skills.name: Light Tank
skills.category: Category 5: Vehicles
skills.description: Consumes 2 Deployment Slots. Armors the trooper inside a Light Tank equipped with a Light Cannon (Rocket Launcher equivalent) and a Fixed Machine Gun.

skills.name: Heavy Tank
skills.category: Category 5: Vehicles
skills.description: Consumes 6 Deployment Slots (requires at least 8 total squad deployment capacity, i.e., at least 4 Scouts). Equipped with a devastating Cannon v.2 (double Infernal Tube payload) and Heavy Machine Gun.

skills.name: Helicopter
skills.category: Category 5: Vehicles
skills.description: Consumes 2 Deployment Slots. Flies above the battlefield (immune to melee and ground obstacles) with high Speed and a Twin Machine Gun.

skills.name: Fighter Jet
skills.category: Category 5: Vehicles
skills.description: Air-strike vehicle where the trooper does not stand on the ground; instead, the Fighter Jet repeatedly bombards the entire enemy battlefield with airstrikes until it runs out of fuel.
